messages:
maria: PR #412 (docs/guides/migration/dropdown) is failing docs CI — linkcheck + vale. preview: https://staging-docs/redwood/pr/412 :frowning:
jing: can you paste the linkcheck output? might be a 403 to an internal doc we accidentally linked
maria: yep: 
```
Linkcheck: Broken external link: https://internal.company.com/ui/dropdown -> 403 Forbidden
Recommended action: remove or replace with public URL
```
devon: that internal link snuck in from the migration notes. We should replace with the public API section and add a small explanatory snippet.
sam: also seeing a vale complaint in the CI log: 
```
vale: ERROR found: 'utilize' in docs/guides/migration/dropdown.md:22
Rule: 'ProseUse' -> prefer 'use' over 'utilize'
```
jing: ugh vale. easy fix though — change 'utilize' -> 'use' and tweak the sentence for clarity. If someone can push a patch I can re-run preview.
devon: I can send a tiny follow-up commit. Will do two changes: remove internal link and replace with public link to /api/components#dropdown; also update wording. Pushing now.
ci-bot: build started for PR #412 — docs-preview + linkcheck + vale
maria: thanks devon :raised_hands:
devon: pushed patch 1782345902 — changed link, updated wording. running linkcheck locally with `npm run docs:linkcheck` looked clean.
jing: re-running preview now.
ci-bot: preview check completed: linkcheck passed; vale still failing on a different line (sentence in examples uses 'enable' -> flagged by 'Tone' rule). Full log: https://ci.example.com/builds/9876/log
maria: hmm which line? I only changed the 'utilize' one.
docs-lead: @maria @devon I can take the last one. If it's Tone we can adjust to active voice. Small wording patch will be faster than arguing with Vale rules.
sam: tagging @docs-lead as reviewer for final approve and merge window — we want this merged before the migration docs cut tomorrow morning.
docs-lead: reviewing now.
docs-lead: tiny nit fixed in-line and approved. CI re-run ok.
ci-bot: PR #412 merge check passed. Merging will require 'merge window' approval from eng-release if outside hours.
maria: does this need eng-release signoff? it's docs only.
sam: ops: since it touches migration guide we want it in today's batch; i'll ping eng-release for a docs-only fast-track.
devon: thanks all — will keep an eye for any follow-up from the docs-preview bot.
maria: great teamwork :party_parrot: — closing thread after merge.
ci-bot: PR #412 merged by docs-bot at 1782346008.
